sanitize_gemini_schema: sanitize a Gemini-compatible copy of a tool parameter schema by stripping unsupported OpenAI keys
sanitize_gemini_tool_parameters: normalize tool parameters to a valid Gemini object schema with fallback empty object
sanitize_gemini_schema_nested: sanitize nested JSON Schema properties, items, and anyOf definitions for Gemini compatibility
sanitize_gemini_schema_recursive: recursively filter JSON Schema dict to only include Gemini's allowed subset of keys
sanitize_gemini_tool_parameters_empty: normalize empty or invalid tool parameters to a default Gemini object schema with empty properties
